Install for Revit 2023:
1. Copy RevitTagAlign.dll and RevitTagAlign.addin to:
   %AppData%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins\2023\
2. Restart Revit 2023
3. Open ribbon tab: Tag Align

Settings file (auto-created when Revit starts — do NOT create manually):
  C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Roaming\RevitTagAlign\AlignConfig.xml

In Revit: Tag Align tab → Settings Folder button
Or in Configure dialog → Open Folder

Keyboard shortcuts:
1. Type KS
2. Search Align Tags → Assign e.g. TA
